facilities.name: Term loan facility (refinanced)
facilities.original: Signed 16 October 2017 mandate letter with a consortium of banks: 5-year, USD 2,250,000 thousand (AED 8,263,130 thousand) unsecured credit facility, bifurcated into a term facility commitment of USD 1,500,000 thousand (AED 5,508,750 thousand) and a revolving facility commitment of USD 750,000 thousand (AED 2,754,380 thousand). No financial covenants in the facility documents.
facilities.original_drawdown: On 16 November 2017 the Group drew down USD 375,000 thousand and AED 4,128,750 thousand.
facilities.original_pricing: USD LIBOR + 0.875% on the USD-denominated portion; EIBOR + 0.60% on the AED-denominated portion.
facilities.refinancing: On 26 October 2022 the Company refinanced its maturing term loan (originally taken in November 2017) for another 5-year term with a set of lenders.
facilities.current_pricing_as_disclosed_FY2023_thro: Variable interest at Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus a margin of 0.85% for the USD-denominated facility portion, and EIBOR plus a margin of 0.60% for the AED-denominated facility portion.
facilities.currency: Split USD / AED tranches; the notes disclose the per-currency margin basis but DO NOT disclose the outstanding USD vs AED tranche amounts at any reporting date.
facilities.maturity: Not stated as an explicit date; disclosed only as 'refinanced ... for another 5-year term' from 26 October 2022 (i.e. implied 2027). Also, in the FY2023 filing: 'The term facility is to be repaid at final maturity which is 5 years from the date of the facility agreement.'
facilities.esg_feature: During 2023 the Company and its lenders agreed to amend and convert the term loan facility to a sustainability-linked loan; the converted facility contains ESG covenants linked to the margin on the loan (FY2023 note 15, p.48). MD&A adds: converted an existing AED 5.5 billion (USD 1.5 billion) term loan into a Sustainability-Linked Loan in January 2023; in 2025 the Company met both KPIs under the SLL framework.

taxation.uae_corporate_tax: UAE domestic corporate tax rate applied is 9% in FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025 per the tax reconciliation tables. The FY2023 note states income tax for the year relates to overseas operations of the Group.

FY2023.note: No effective tax rate line is printed in the FY2024 filing's FY2023 column; the FY2025 filing prints ETR only for 2025 and 2024.

taxation.pillar_two_dmtt: UAE published Federal Decree-Law No. 60 of 2023 (24 Nov 2023). Cabinet Decision No. 142 of 2024, released 11 February 2025, details the UAE Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (DMTT) applying to fiscal years starting on or after 1 January 2025, ensuring a 15% effective tax rate on UAE profits of in-scope MNE entities. For FY2025 the Group applied the transitional CbCR safe harbour simplified ETR test; jurisdictional ETR exceeded 15%, so no top-up tax arose. Relief available until 31 December 2027. Both 2026 interims repeat that no significant DMTT impact is anticipated.

inventory_movements.unit: AED million (as published in MD&A / IR decks). NOT AED'000.
inventory_movements.definition_note: Inventory gains/losses reflect timing differences between procurement costs and retail price changes and 'can be volatile' (2025 Integrated Report p.37). They are NOT a separately presented line in the audited financial statements — they are disclosed only in MD&A commentary and IR decks. There is no reconciliation from the audited accounts to these figures in any supplied document.
inventory_movements.coverage_gap: NO inventory gain/loss figure for FY2023 or FY2022 exists in any supplied file. The FY2025 MD&A carries only 2025 and 2024; the FY2023/FY2024 MD&A and IR decks were not supplied. The 2025 Integrated Report repeats only the 2025 vs 2024 pair. A through-cycle average can therefore be computed over FY2024, FY2025, H1-2026 (and their quarterly splits) ONLY.

totalenergies_marketing_egypt_treatment.note_on_goodwill_movement: Group goodwill and intangible assets fell from AED 1,053,811 thousand (FY2023) to AED 599,307 thousand (FY2024) — driven by EGP translation (FCTR moved from -2,995 to -298,268 and NCI fell 323,767 to 189,437 in the same year) rather than a disposal; Egypt intangibles per the geographical segment note went 1,052,683 (FY2023) -> 598,178 (FY2024) -> 620,724 (FY2025).

restatements.item: IAS 21 amendments — opening equity restatement at 1 January 2024
restatements.description: The FY2024 statement of changes in equity shows 'Adjustments of IAS 21 amendments (note 2)' reducing 1 January 2024 balances: retained earnings/equity attributable to owners -AED 33,979 thousand and non-controlling interests -AED 33,982 thousand, total equity -AED 67,961 thousand. Adjusted opening balances: equity attributable to owners AED 3,438,087 thousand, NCI AED 289,785 thousand, total equity AED 3,727,872 thousand.
restatements.effect: FY2023 reported P&L and balance sheet were NOT restated; the adjustment was taken to opening 2024 equity only. Therefore closing FY2023 total equity of AED 3,795,833 thousand does not equal adjusted opening FY2024 total equity of AED 3,727,872 thousand.
restatements.which_taken: Both recorded. FY2023 balance sheet figures in this file are as reported/comparative (unchanged between the FY2023 and FY2024 filings).

restatements.item: FY2023 income-statement presentation of impairment losses
restatements.description: The FY2023 filing presents two separate lines: 'Impairment losses on trade and other receivables' AED (27,766) thousand and 'Other impairment losses and expenses' AED (54,377) thousand. The FY2024 filing re-presents the FY2023 comparative as a single line 'Impairment losses and other operating expenses' AED (90,254)/(82,143) thousand.
restatements.effect: Presentational only — 27,766 + 54,377 = 82,143. No change to operating profit or net profit.
restatements.which_taken: The FY2024 filing's single-line comparative (82,143) is used as the primary FY2023 figure; both original lines are also recorded.

restatements.description: The FY2023 filing's capital-risk note prints 'Equity 3,472,072' and 'Net debt plus equity 5,970,415' for 31 December 2023, whereas the FY2023 balance sheet (p.14 of the same filing) and the FY2024 filing's version of the same table both show equity attributable to owners of AED 3,472,066 thousand and net debt plus equity of AED 5,970,409 thousand. A AED 6 thousand internal inconsistency in the FY2023 filing.

restatements.item: FY2025 Egypt short-term borrowing — AED translation of the drawn EGP amount
restatements.description: The FY2025 borrowings note states EGP 602,387 thousand drawn = 'AED 43,384 thousand', while the balance sheet and the same note's short-term borrowing line show AED 46,384 thousand. A 3,000-thousand difference internal to the FY2025 filing (apparent typo in the note narrative).
restatements.which_taken: The balance-sheet figure of AED 46,384 thousand for the reported short-term borrowings balance; the note's narrative figure is recorded verbatim in the borrowings block.

restatements.item: TotalEnergies Marketing Egypt dividend in respect of FY2023 — approval date
restatements.description: The FY2024 filing states the AED 41,057 thousand TEME dividend in respect of FY2023 was approved at the General Assembly Meeting held on 23 April 2024. The FY2025 filing states the same AED 41,057 thousand dividend for the same year was approved on 23 April 2023.
restatements.which_taken: The FY2024 filing's date (23 April 2024) appears correct on its face (a dividend in respect of FY2023 approved after year end); both recorded.

restatements.item: TotalEnergies Marketing Egypt dividend in respect of FY2024 — amount and date
restatements.description: The FY2025 filing states a TEME dividend of AED 55,792 thousand in respect of FY2024, approved at the AGM held on 22 April 2024. The H1-2026 interim states AED 55,793 thousand in respect of FY2024, approved at the AGM held on 22 April 2025.
restatements.which_taken: The more recent H1-2026 figure (55,793; AGM 22 April 2025) is the more internally coherent (a FY2024 dividend approved in 2025); both recorded.

restatements.description: The FY2025 MD&A financial summary prints 2024 underlying EBITDA of AED 3,633 million. The 2025 Integrated Report (p.117) states 2025 underlying EBITDA of AED 4,001 million is '+10.1% compared to AED 3,663 million in 2024'.
restatements.which_taken: The MD&A financial-summary figure (3,633) is treated as primary because it sits in the tabulated summary; the Integrated Report figure (3,663) is recorded as the discrepancy. Note 4,001/3,633 = +10.1% and 4,001/3,663 = +9.2%, so the stated +10.1% growth rate is consistent with 3,633.

restatements.item: H1 2026 inventory gains — segment split vs total
restatements.description: Published as total AED 762 million with a split of AED 528 million fuel retail and AED 233 million commercial (sum 761). A 1-unit rounding difference in the company's own printed figures.

restatements.item: Convenience-store conversion rate improvement in 2025 — stated base year
restatements.description: The FY2025 MD&A states conversion rate 'increased by 50 bps from 26.1% in 2024 to 26.6% in 2025' (and the operational-highlights page shows '+50 bps ... compared to 26.1% in 2024'). The 2025 Integrated Report p.36 states the rate 'increased by 45 basis points to 26.6%' and separately '+45bps compared to 26.1% in 2023'.
restatements.which_taken: Both recorded. The 2024 metrics table (MD&A p.20) prints 26.1% for 2024, so the Integrated Report's '2023' label is probably an error, but it is recorded as printed.

restatements.description: The FY2025 MD&A prints 2024 fuel-retail revenue of AED 22,223 million and 2024 retail-segment revenue of AED 23,799 million. The 2025 Integrated Report p.37 key-financials table prints 2024 revenue-fuel of AED 22,225 million, revenue non-fuel AED 1,574 million and total retail revenue AED 23,798 million.
restatements.which_taken: MD&A figures (which tie to the audited revenue note: retail fuel 22,223,252 thousand; retail non-fuel 1,575,410 thousand).

restatements.description: FY2025 note 35 states: 'Certain comparative figures have been reclassified from prior year, wherever necessary, to conform to the presentation adopted in the current year.' No specific reclassifications are itemised.
restatements.which_taken: Not applicable — no quantified effect disclosed.
